captions.caption: A man stands by a calm river with a fishing rod in hand.
The man successfully catches a small fish and lifts it from the water.
He approaches the camera, showing off the perch he just caught.
The man holds the perch up to the camera for a clear view.
He continues to display the fish while talking about his fishing progress.
The perch dangles from the fishing line in front of the camera.
The man explains he will cook the perch in a pot.
He mentions catching other types of fish like trout and chubs.
The man keeps the fish steady as he describes its size relative to others.
He gestures toward the fish while discussing his total catch.
The perch remains the central focus of the shot as the man speaks.
The man continues his explanation about the various fish he has caught.
He adjusts the fishing rod slightly while still showing the perch.
The man looks off-camera as if responding to someone.
He pauses his explanation to listen to an off-screen voice.
The man clarifies his statement to the person off-camera.
He finishes his brief conversation while still holding the perch.
The man turns away and starts walking toward the riverbank.
He walks past the camera, heading toward the water's edge.
The camera focus shifts to his legs as he stands near the water.
A close-up view shows the man's lower body as he prepares to clean the fish.
The man begins cutting the fish on a wooden log near the water.
He uses a sharp knife to make a precise cut near the fish's head.
The man continues slicing through the perch on the log.
He carefully works the knife along the body of the fish.
He continues to cut the fish precisely with the knife.
The man works the blade through the tough skin of the perch.
He maintains steady pressure while slicing the fish on the log.
The man adjusts his grip on the fish to make a better cut.
He finishes the main slicing task and prepares for the next step.
The man continues applying pressure with the knife to clean the fish.
He successfully severs a portion of the fish using the knife.
The man works on removing the head and internal parts of the fish.
He finishes the initial cut and prepares to remove the guts.
The man uses his hands to begin pulling the entrails from the perch.
He carefully extracts the internal organs from the fish's body cavity.
The man continues cleaning out the inside of the fish.
He pulls a significant portion of the guts out of the perch.
The man ensures all unwanted parts are removed from the fish.
He holds the cleaned fish over the water to rinse it.
The man tosses the removed fish guts into the flowing river.
He reaches back into the fish to remove any remaining bits.
The man continues to clean the interior of the perch thoroughly.
He throws more of the internal organs into the water.
The man inspects the fish to make sure it is clean.
He begins rinsing the perch directly in the river water.
The man uses both hands to wash the fish in the stream.
He continues to rinse the perch, removing blood and debris.
The man dips the fish back into the water for a final rinse.
He holds the fish under the water, cleaning it meticulously.
The man splashes water onto the fish to get it completely clean.
He continues washing the perch in the cold river water.
The man rubs the fish while it's submerged to ensure cleanliness.
He lifts the fish slightly out of the water to check its condition.
The man continues the rinsing process in the river.
He remarks on the small amount of meat on the fish.
The man continues to wash the perch while talking to himself.
He rinses the internal cavity of the fish one more time.
The man mentions how this fish will add to his total meal.
He finishes rinsing the perch and prepares to cook it.
